### 14.

Strabōn, biblion 15, selis 692: peri tou bosmorou, hon Onesikritos phēsi siton einai pyrou elattō, phyomenon de en tois metaxy tōn potamōn chōriois. phrygetai de thēomenos, kai horkous lambanousin hoi anthrōpoi mē ekkomizein auton ek tēs halōnos aphrygton, hina mē exagētai to sperma.
paraballe Diodōron, biblion 2, kephalaion 36, hopou ta biblia tēn graphēn "bosporon" deiknysin. hora Stephanou Thēsauron hypo "bosmoron." — "sitos": houtō phēsi ho tēs Epitomēs syngrapheus; ta de tou Strabōnos antigrapha "septos" phēsin.

### 15.

Strabōn, biblion 15, selis 694: hē India polla kai thaumasta dendra phyei, hōn hen esti tōn kladōn katapherōn, ta de phylla ou elattō aspidos. Onesikritos de, akribesteron peri tēs Musikanou chōras dialegomenos, hēn notiōtatēn tēs Indikēs einai phēsi, dendra tina megala perigraphe, hōn hoi kladoi anō phuontai epi dōdeka pēcheis, epeita tēn loipēn auxēsin katō pherontai, hōsper kamphthentes, mechri an tēs gēs hapsōntai. epeita, dia tēs gēs diaspiremenoi, rhizountai kathaper paraphytades, eita anistamenoi stelechos apotelousin. ek de toutou palin kamphthentes kata ton auton tropon tēs auxēseōs, heteran paraphytada poiountai, kai epeita allēn, kai houtō kathexēs, hōste ex henos dendrou makran skian apotelesthēnai,

eoikuian skēnēi pollous kionas echousēi. mnēmoneuei de kai tou megethous tōn dendrōn, phaskōn ta steleche tosouton einai to megethos hōste pente andras molis perilambanein auta.
paraballe Aristoboulon, apospasma 30, hopou legetai hoti Aristoboulos periegraphe dendra tosoutou megethous hōste pentēkonta hippeis anapauesthai an hypo tēi skiai henos; Strabōn de epipherei: "houtos de (Onesikritos) tetrakosious phēsin." Nearchos, apospasma 40; Diodōros, biblion 17, kephalaion 90.

### 16.

Strabōn, biblion 15, selis 693: to de tous potamous hyperpleizein kai tous chersaious anemous mē pnein, kyroutai hypo tōn hypo Onesikritou legomenōn. phēsi gar tēn paralian tēs Indikēs helōdē einai, malista de kata tas tōn potamōn ekbolas, dia tēn ilyn, tas plēmyras, kai tēn tōn thalassiōn anemōn epikrateian.
"ho logos toude tou apospasmatos kyroi ta hypo Aristoboulou peri tēs tōn Indikōn potamōn plēmyras en tōi 29i apospasmati diegēmena." — GEIER. hora katō, apospasma 20.

### 17.

Strabōn, biblion 15, selis 695: peri de toutou (tēs doxis hoti to hydōr to ek tōn nephōn ēdē hephthon estin hotan ekcheitai), hoi peri Aristoboulon ouk an homologoien, phaskontes mē hyesthai epi tōn pediōn. Onesikritōi de dokei touto to hydōr aition einai tōn peri ta zōa idiōmatōn. parechetai de tekmerion hoti ta tōn xenōn ktenōn chrōmata eis to epichōrion metaballei hotan pinōsi touto. touto men oun kalōs eirētai; ou mentoi eti orthōs poiei, tēn aitian tōn Aithiōpōn melas einai kai oulotrichas haplōs eis to hydōr tithemenos, kai

oneidizei Theodektēi tēn aitian eis ton hēlion auton anapemptonti, kathaper ekeinos ho syngrapheus phēsi:

kai toi Onesikritos an echoi tina logon; phēsi gar ton hēlion mē mallon engys einai tois Aithiōsin ē tois allois, alla mallon kata katheton kai dia touto mallon kaiein. houtō de phēsi mē kalōs eirēsthai ton hēlion "synorizein" autois, epeidē ison diastēma pantōn estin. epicheirei de kai hoti hē thermotēs ouk estin aition toioutou pathous, epeidē ouch houtōs echei tois en tēi nēdyi, hous ouch haptetai ho hēlios.
